WITH cohort_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort,
        COUNT(*) as cohort_size,
        contact_notes
    FROM participants
    GROUP BY cohort, contact_notes
)
INSERT INTO cohort_summary (cohort, cohort_size, example_comment)
SELECT 
    cohort,
    MIN(cohort_size) as cohort_size,
    MIN(contact_notes) as example_comment
FROM cohort_data
GROUP BY cohort;
SELECT * FROM cohort_summary ORDER BY cohort;

WITH cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) as cohort_size FROM participants GROUP BY cohort
),
cohort_examples AS (
    SELECT cohort, MIN(contact_notes) as example_comment 
    FROM participants 
    GROUP BY cohort
)
INSERT INTO cohort_summary (cohort, cohort_size, example_comment)
SELECT cs.cohort, cs.cohort_size, ce.example_comment
FROM cohort_sizes cs
JOIN cohort_examples ce ON cs.cohort = ce.cohort;
SELECT * FROM cohort_summary ORDER BY cohort;
